# FirePencil.AI

> The autonomous AEO Agent that makes AI trust your brand. Trust becomes visibility in every AI answer. Private beta — limited spots.

## Pages

- [Home](https://firepencil.ai): Homepage.
- [Generate LLMS.TXT For Your Website](https://firepencil.ai/llms-txt-generator): Free llms.txt generator. We crawl your site and build a valid llms.txt so ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overviews can read, understand and cite your brand. No signup — your first step in AEO.
- [How to Get Cited in AI Answers (AEO Playbook)](https://firepencil.ai/blog/how-to-get-cited-in-ai-answers/): A practical playbook for getting your brand cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews — and how to choose the best AEO, GEO or AI SEO tool.
- [Privacy Policy](https://firepencil.ai/privacy-policy.html): How FirePencil.AI collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our website and services.
